quote: Asuntojen, majoitustilojen, hoitolaitosten, päivähoitolaitosten, päiväkotien ja muiden varhaiskasvatuksen tilojen sekä koulujen on oltava varustettu tarkoituksenmukaisella laitteistolla, joka varhaisessa vaiheessa ilmoittaa alkavasta palosta.
en: Schools, among others, must be equipped with an appropriate device that gives early warning of an incipient fire. Table 12: up to 250 pupils a mains-connected smoke alarm; 251 to 500 a fire alarm system; over 500 a fire alarm system connected to the emergency response centre.
limit: Requires the system for the building. It does not name rooms.

value: 1,200 mm wide, 2,100 mm high
quote: Uloskäytävän leveyden on oltava vähintään 1 200 millimetriä ja uloskäytävän korkeuden on oltava vähintään 2 100 millimetriä.
en: An exit must be at least 1,200 mm wide and 2,100 mm high. Exceptions follow in the same section (for example a second exit of 900 mm where the escape area holds at most 60 people).

topic: travel distance to the nearest exit
value: 45 m in general for 'other spaces'; 30 m where there is only one exit
quote: Kulkureitin pituus lähimpään uloskäytävään ei saa olla vaaraa aiheuttavan pitkä.
en: The travel distance to the nearest exit must not be dangerously long. Table 10 gives the maximum by use of the escape area.
limit: Table 10 has footnotes and higher values for areas with a smoke-detection fire alarm or sprinklers; read the table before using a single figure.

value: opens in the direction of escape when more than 60 people use the door
quote: Ovien on avauduttava poistumissuuntaan jos kyseessä on asunnon kerrostaso-ovi tai oven kautta poistuvien henkilöiden määrä on yli 60.
en: Doors must open in the direction of escape if more than 60 people leave through the door.

doc: Indoor climate and ventilation of new buildings, decree 1009/2017
value: 6 dm³/s per person
quote: Oleskelutilojen ulkoilmavirraksi on mitoitettava vähintään 6 dm³/s henkilöä kohti suunniteltuna käyttöaikana, jos tilan käyttötarkoituksesta ei aiheudu lisäilmavirran tarvetta.
en: Occupied spaces must be designed for at least 6 dm³/s of outdoor air per person during the designed period of use.

value: 850 mm on an internal route; 800 mm into rooms
quote: Rakennuksen sisäisellä kulkuväylällä olevan oven ja aukon [...] vapaan leveyden on oltava vähintään 850 millimetriä.
quote_2: Muun rakennuksen kuin asuinrakennuksen huonetiloihin [...] johtavan oven ja kulkuaukon vapaan leveyden on oltava vähintään 800 millimetriä.
en: A door or opening on an internal route must have a clear width of at least 850 mm. A door into a room of a non-residential building must have at least 800 mm.

topic: turning space on a narrow route
value: route under 1,500 mm wide needs a 1,500 mm turning space every 15 m
quote: Jos 1 momentissa tarkoitettu kulkuväylä on leveydeltään alle 1 500 millimetriä, kulkuväylällä on oltava vähintään 15 metrin välein kääntymistila, jonka halkaisija on vähintään 1 500 millimetriä.
en: If the route is narrower than 1,500 mm, it must have a turning space of at least 1,500 mm diameter at least every 15 metres.

value: 1,500 mm free circle; 800 mm free on each side of the seat
quote: Edellä 1 momentissa tarkoitetussa wc-tilassa on oltava halkaisijaltaan vähintään 1 500 millimetriä vapaa tila. [...] Lisäksi wc-istuimen kummallakin puolella on oltava vapaata tilaa vähintään 800 millimetriä.
en: The accessible toilet must have a free space of at least 1,500 mm diameter, and at least 800 mm free on each side of the seat (or two toilets side by side, one free on the left and one on the right).

topic: landing in front of the entrance door
quote: Ulko-oven edessä olevan tasanteen on oltava vähintään 1 500 millimetriä leveä ja vähintään 1500 millimetriä pitkä.
en: The landing in front of an exterior door must be at least 1,500 mm wide and 1,500 mm long.

doc: Dwelling, accommodation and work spaces, decree 1008/2017
value: 7 m² and 2.5 m
quote: Asuin-, majoitus- ja työtilan huonealan on kuitenkin aina oltava vähintään 7 neliömetriä. Asuin-, majoitus- ja työtilan huonekorkeuden on oltava vähintään 2,5 metriä.
en: A dwelling, accommodation or work space must always have a room area of at least 7 m² and a room height of at least 2.5 m.
limit: Applies to dwelling, accommodation and work spaces. Whether a classroom counts as a work space under this decree was not checked.

doc: Dwelling, accommodation and work spaces, decree 1008/2017
value: light opening at least 1/10 of the room area
quote: Jos työtilassa on oltava ikkuna, valoaukon on oltava vähintään 1/10 työtilan huonealasta.
en: If a work space must have a window, its light opening must be at least one tenth of the room area.

doc: Safety in use of buildings, decree 1007/2017
topic: stair riser and going in an exit
value: riser at most 180 mm, going at least 270 mm
quote: Uloskäytävässä portaan askelman nousu voi olla enintään 180 millimetriä. Etenemän on oltava vähintään 270 millimetriä.
en: In an exit, the riser of a stair may be at most 180 mm and the going must be at least 270 mm.

doc: Safety in use of buildings, decree 1007/2017
value: required above a 0.5 m drop; 1.0 m high (1.2 m above a 6 m drop)
quote: Rakennuksessa tai sen lähiympäristössä on oltava kaide, kun putoamiskorkeus ylittää puoli metriä ja putoamisen tai harhaan astumisen vaara on olemassa, eikä toiminnan luonne edellytä kaiteettomuutta.
en: A guard rail is required where the fall height exceeds half a metre and there is a risk of falling.

quote: Rakennuksen, jossa on potilashuoneita, opetus-, kokous-, ruokailu-, hoito-, harrastus-, liikunta- tai toimistotiloja, ääniolosuhteet on suunniteltava ja toteutettava siten, että tilassa saavutetaan sen käyttötarkoitus huomioon ottaen riittävä puheenerotettavuus.
en: In buildings with teaching, meeting, dining, care, hobby, sports or office spaces, acoustic conditions must give sufficient speech intelligibility for the use of the space.
limit: Sets a goal, not a number. It cannot be checked from a floor plan.

value: 32 inches (815 mm)
quote: Door openings shall provide a clear width of 32 inches (815 mm) minimum.

value: 36 inches (915 mm)
quote: Except as provided in 403.5.2 and 403.5.3, the clear width of walking surfaces shall be 36 inches (915 mm) minimum.

topic: turning space in a toilet room
value: 60 inches (1525 mm) diameter
quote: The turning space shall be a space of 60 inches (1525 mm) diameter minimum.
quote_2: Turning space complying with 304 shall be provided within the room.

value: 60 inches from the side wall, 56 inches from the rear wall
quote: Clearance around a water closet shall be 60 inches (1525 mm) minimum measured perpendicular from the side wall and 56 inches (1420 mm) minimum measured perpendicular from the rear wall.

topic: which toilet rooms must be accessible
quote: Where toilet rooms are provided, each toilet room shall comply with 603.
limit: Exceptions follow in the same section.

quote: Where provided, kitchens, kitchenettes, and sinks shall comply with 212.
limit: Section 804, which holds the kitchen clearances, was not extracted.

value: not steeper than 1:12
quote: Ramp runs shall have a running slope not steeper than 1:12.

doc: International Fire Code as adopted by Washington State (WAC 51-54A)
value: manual fire alarm system; not required at an occupant load of 50 or less
quote: Group E occupancies shall be provided with a manual fire alarm system that initiates the occupant notification signal [...]
quote_2: A manual fire alarm system is not required in Group E occupancies with an occupant load of 50 or less.
limit: This is Washington State's amended wording. Other states adopt the model code with their own changes; the model code publisher's site refused automated access, so the unamended text was not checked.

doc: International Fire Code as adopted by Washington State (WAC 51-54A)
clause: Table 1004.5 Maximum floor area allowances per occupant
topic: occupant load: floor area per person
value: classroom 20 net sq ft (1.86 m²); shops and vocational rooms 50 net; commercial kitchens 200 gross
quote: Educational: Classroom area 20 net; Shops and other vocational room areas 50 net
limit: This factor sets how many people the exits must serve. It is not a minimum classroom size: a room may hold more people if the exits allow.

status: model code, adopted by states with changes
value: 72 inches in Group E with a corridor occupant load of 100 or more; 44 inches in general
limit: Reported by a city permitting presentation and a trade guide. The code text itself was not retrieved.

status: model code, adopted by states with changes
value: recalled as 200 ft without sprinklers and 250 ft with, for Group E
limit: From memory. No source was retrieved. Do not show without checking.
